description: This file contains common definitions, macros, and debug configurations for the PTM driver in the UEIP project, specifically for the Lantiq hardware platform. It defines version numbers, compile options, debug masks, and logging macros.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Logs error messages if error debugging is enabled.

methods.name: dbg
methods.description: Logs debug messages if debug printing is enabled.

methods.name: ASSERT
methods.description: Checks a condition and logs an assertion failure if the condition is false and assertions are enabled.
